entry.title: JWST MEP-A World Under Spotty Starlight: Detection of CO2 and H2O in the Hot Saturn WASP-52b with JWST NIRSpec G395H
entry.content:
Authors: Y Pan, R MacDonald, N Espinoza, B Prinoth...

Abstract: Exoplanets orbiting active stars offer distinct challenges for atmospheric characterization with the JWST. Among such worlds, the hot Saturn WASP-52b (Teq∼ 1300K) orbits an active K-dwarf that complicates transmission spectroscopy ...
